title: Bamboo Nutrient Deficiency: Signs, Causes and the Fertilizer That Fixes It
metaTitle: Bamboo Nutrient Deficiency: Signs and Fertilizer Fix
metaDescription: Bamboo nutrient deficiency shows in the leaves. See the signs of nitrogen, potassium and phosphorus in kawayan, how to be sure, and the fertilizer to apply.
excerpt: Bamboo nutrient deficiency is one of the first things to check when the leaves of your kawayan (bamboo) turn yellow, purple or burnt at the edges. On Philippine farms the usual ones are nitrogen, potassium, phosphorus, magnesium and iron. This guide shows where each one starts, how to be sure, and the fertilizer that fixes it.

heroImage.credit: Maja Dumat, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr

blocks.text: Start with one question: did the change begin on the old leaves or on the young ones? Nitrogen, potassium, phosphorus and magnesium move inside the plant, so a shortage shows on the old, lower leaves first. But iron stay where the plant first put them, so the young leaves and the growing tip show it first. After that, the color and the pattern narrow down which bamboo nutrient deficiency you have, and a soil test confirms it. Each one below has its signs, its causes and its fix.
Bamboo nutrient deficiency signs, old leaves and young leaves
Shows first on the old leaves

blocks.text: Before you buy fertilizer for a bamboo nutrient deficiency

So use the table to pick the likeliest bamboo nutrient deficiency, then read its section below. Also keep in mind that dry soil, standing water, cold nights, a pest or a disease can look the same. That is why it pays to check the roots and the whole field first.
Nitrogen deficiency in bamboo

No bamboo particular description of this shortage was found, so this follows general plant signs for grasses and leafy plants. Older leaves turn pale green to yellow first, then the whole clump looks light green. Few new shoots come up, and the culms that form are thin and short. Bamboo needs nitrogen in larger amounts than phosphorus or potash. You see it most at this stage: young plantings and old clumps that are cut every year without feeding.
Why nitrogen deficiency happens in kawayan
Yearly harvests of shoots and poles carry nitrogen away, and most clumps are never fertilized. Eroded slopes and sandy riverbanks low in organic matter make it worse.
How to tell it apart

Bamboo also drops old leaves in the dry season and while new shoots grow, which is normal. Spider mites leave fine yellow to white specks and webbing under the leaves, and rust leaves orange to brown powdery spots underneath. To be sure, A soil test for nitrogen and organic matter. In the Dumanjug, Cebu study, the most productive kawayan tinik plots had about 0.89 percent soil nitrogen and 4.8 percent organic matter.
What to apply for nitrogen deficiency

For old kawayan tinik clumps, a study in Batac found that 2 kg of Complete 14 14 14 per clump per year, together with sanitation cutting, gave more and bigger shoots and culms. For nursery plantlets, a study found 0.25 grams of nitrogen per plant was enough. Ammonium sulfate worked better than calcium nitrate. 0.25 grams of nitrogen is about 1.2 grams of Ammonium sulfate 21 0 0.

Sold here with nitrogen: **Atlas Granular Urea** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (46 0 0), **YaraVera Viking Ship Granular Urea** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (46 0 0), **Planters Products Granular Urea** by Planters Products, Inc. (46 0 0) and **Harbest Granular Urea** by Harbest Agribusiness Corporation (46 0 0). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [urea fertilizer](/blog/urea-fertilizer), and the page on [nitrogen deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/nitrogen-deficiency) in every crop. In anee.io, Anee, the [smart farm technician](/features/ai-agricultural-technician), reads a photo of the leaf and tells you which nutrient is short.
To keep it away, fertilize clumps every year, keep the leaf litter under the clump, and remove old and dead culms.
Potassium deficiency in bamboo

No bamboo particular description of this shortage was found, so this follows general plant signs for grasses and leafy plants. Older leaves yellow and then dry brown at the tips and edges, while the middle of the leaf stays green longer. New shoots and culms stay smaller. You see it most at this stage: clumps harvested every year, on sandy or leached soils.
Why potassium deficiency happens in kawayan
Sandy, leached soils and heavy harvests. In the Dumanjug, Cebu study, exchangeable potassium was one of the soil traits that predicted the number of new shoots.
How to tell it apart

Bamboo also drops old leaves in the dry season and while new shoots grow, which is normal. Spider mites leave fine yellow to white specks and webbing under the leaves, and rust leaves orange to brown powdery spots underneath. To be sure, A soil test for potash. Compare with the Dumanjug productive plots, which had about 206 ppm exchangeable potassium.
What to apply for potassium deficiency

Use a complete fertilizer such as Complete 14 14 14, or add Muriate of potash 0 0 60 where a soil test shows potash is low. No bamboo potash rate from a Philippine source was found, so follow the soil test.

Sold here with potassium: **Atlas Muriate of Potash** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (0 0 60), **Philphos Muriate of Potash** by Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corporation (0 0 60), **Harbest Granular Muriate of Potash** by Harbest Agribusiness Corporation (0 0 60) and **Swire Muriate of Potash** by Swire Agrotech Agricultural Products Inc. (0 0 60). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [potash fertilizer](/blog/potash-fertilizer), and the page on [potassium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/potassium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, return leaf litter and chopped branches to the clump, and fertilize every year.
Phosphorus deficiency in bamboo

No bamboo particular description of this shortage was found, so this follows general plant signs for grasses and leafy plants. The clump spreads slowly and sends up few new shoots and culms. Leaves can look dull dark green and growth is slow, especially in young plantings. You see it most at this stage: the first years after planting, and on old, poor soils.
Why phosphorus deficiency happens in kawayan
Acid, weathered and eroded soils that hold phosphorus. In the Dumanjug, Cebu study, available phosphorus helped explain clump spread, culm numbers and shoot numbers.
How to tell it apart

Nitrogen shortage also cuts shoot numbers, but leaves turn pale instead of dark. Root and rhizome damage from digging or waterlogging also slows clumps. To be sure, A soil test for available phosphorus and pH, compared with about 13.9 ppm found in the productive Dumanjug plots.
What to apply for phosphorus deficiency

Put phosphate in the planting hole and feed clumps with a complete fertilizer such as Complete 14 14 14 or 16 20 0. Superphosphate 0 20 0 can be added where a soil test shows phosphorus is low. Follow the soil test for the rate.

Sold here with phosphorus: **Triple Super Phosphate** by Newman Chemicals Corporation (0 46 0), **Sagrex Duofos Granular Guano Phosphate** by Sagrex Corporation (0 22 0 (guano phosphate)), **Philphos 18 46 0** by Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corporation (18 46 0 (diammonium phosphate)) and **Atlas Di Ammonium Phosphate** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (18 46 0). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [16 20 0 fertilizer](/blog/16-20-0-fertilizer), and the page on [phosphorus deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/phosphorus-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, add compost or manure at planting and keep the leaf litter in place.
Magnesium deficiency in bamboo

No bamboo particular description of this shortage was found, so this follows general plant signs for grasses and leafy plants. Older leaves yellow between the veins, which in a grass leaf shows as yellow streaks along green veins. Culms come thinner and lighter. You see it most at this stage: established clumps on acid, leached soils.
Why magnesium deficiency happens in kawayan
Acid, sandy and leached soils. In the Dumanjug, Cebu study, exchangeable magnesium was one of the soil traits that best predicted culm diameter, culm height and culm dry weight.
How to tell it apart

Bamboo also drops old leaves in the dry season and while new shoots grow, which is normal. Spider mites leave fine yellow to white specks and webbing under the leaves, and rust leaves orange to brown powdery spots underneath. To be sure, A soil test for magnesium, potash and pH.
What to apply for magnesium deficiency

On acid soil, apply Dolomite, which supplies magnesium and raises pH. Magnesium sulfate (Epsom salt) or Kieserite can also be used. No bamboo rate from a Philippine source was found, so follow the soil test.

Sold here with magnesium: **Dolomite** by A6 Agrisource Limited Corporation (24 percent calcium and 11 percent magnesium), **YaraTera KRISTA MgS** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (16 percent MgO and 13 percent sulfur), **Magnepro** by Ramgo International Corporation (16 percent MgO and 12.8 percent sulfur) and **Lucky Planters Magnesium Sulphate Heptahydrate (Epsom Salt)** by Mindanao Agriplus Corporation (16.27 percent MgO and 13 percent sulfur). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [complete fertilizer](/blog/complete-fertilizer-14-14-14), and the page on [magnesium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/magnesium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, keep potash and magnesium in balance with a soil test and lime acid soils with dolomite.
Iron deficiency in bamboo

No bamboo particular description of this shortage was found, so this follows general plant signs for grasses and leafy plants. The newest leaves turn yellow while the veins stay green. In bad cases whole new leaves turn yellow to white and their edges may brown. You see it most at this stage: new growth, on high pH soils.
Why iron deficiency happens in kawayan
Iron is locked up in alkaline soils above about pH 7.5, especially where limestone is plentiful, as Arizona extension notes. Waterlogged or compacted soil makes it worse.
How to tell it apart
Nitrogen shortage yellows the older leaves first, not the new ones. Magnesium shortage streaks the older leaves. To be sure, A soil test for pH. A test spray of iron on a few branches.
What to apply for iron deficiency

Spray chelated iron or Ferrous sulfate on the leaves, as Arizona extension advises. It shows results within a few weeks but may need repeating each year. On high pH soil, soil sulfur lowers the pH so iron becomes available. Follow the label for rates.

Sold here with iron: **Ferrous Sulphate Heptahydrate** by Cleveland Industries Inc. (20 percent iron), **Ferrous Sulfate Monohydrate** by Zetryl.Chem Phils., Inc. (30 percent iron), **Grow More Liquid Chelate Iron with Sulfur** by Sagrex Corporation (5 percent iron and 3 percent sulfur) and **Biozome** by Manchem Industries, Inc. (12 percent S, 12 percent Zn, 3 percent Mn, 1 percent Mg, 1 percent Fe, 1 percent Cu, 0.5 percent B, 0.05 percent Mo). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [foliar fertilizer](/blog/foliar-fertilizer), and the page on [iron deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/iron-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, do not lime soils that are already near neutral, add organic matter, and keep the soil well drained.

blocks.title: Let a soil test decide the rate
blocks.text: A soil test is the surest check for any bamboo nutrient deficiency. Before you buy, ask your Municipal Agriculture Office where to send a soil sample. The DA regional soil laboratories test soil, and the result says how much of each fertilizer your kawayan needs. That saves money, because extra fertilizer is money lost.

blocks.text: Bamboo nutrient deficiency questions

items.q: Why are my kawayan leaves turning yellow?
items.a: The most common cause is nitrogen deficiency: the clump turns pale yellow green, older leaves yellow first, and new shoots come few and thin. If the young leaves turn yellow first instead, look at iron deficiency.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes nitrogen deficiency in bamboo?
items.a: For old kawayan tinik clumps, a study in Batac found that 2 kg of Complete 14 14 14 per clump per year, together with sanitation cutting, gave more and bigger shoots and culms. For nursery plantlets, a study found 0.25 grams of nitrogen per plant was enough.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes potassium deficiency in bamboo?
items.a: Use a complete fertilizer such as Complete 14 14 14, or add Muriate of potash 0 0 60 where a soil test shows potash is low. No bamboo potash rate from a Philippine source was found, so follow the soil test.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes phosphorus deficiency in bamboo?
items.a: Put phosphate in the planting hole and feed clumps with a complete fertilizer such as Complete 14 14 14 or 16 20 0. Superphosphate 0 20 0 can be added where a soil test shows phosphorus is low.

items.q: How do I know which nutrient my kawayan lacks?
items.a: First look at where the change began, on the old leaves or the young ones, then at the color and the pattern. Next, confirm the bamboo nutrient deficiency with a soil test or a leaf test before you buy fertilizer.
